**Finding: MFN — compliant (preferred position).**

No most-favoured-nation obligation runs against Bluefly anywhere in the agreement. The pricing provisions (§ 4.1 Charges, § 4.2 Payment) are purely one-directional — IBM invoices the charges set out in Service Option Attachments and Order Forms — and the only pricing-adjustment mechanic (§ 13.1) is an IBM-side price change right exercisable no earlier than 12 months after the Service Option Attachment Start Date on 90 days' notice, paired with our right to terminate without termination charges. Section 13.3 confirms other amendments require both parties' signatures. Targeted searches for best-price, most-favoured-customer, "no less favorable", right-to-match and benchmarking language returned nothing, and § 14.16 expressly preserves each party's freedom to contract with others.

Accordingly the preferred element ("Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor") is already met and no redline is proposed.
